content: {"praised":["Historical accuracy and faithful adaptation of Cornelius Ryan's book","All-star cast featuring Connery, Caine, Hopkins, Hackman, Redford","Captures the scale and drama of Operation Market-Garden","Strong war film tone and thematic focus on WWII operations","Well-acted performances by leading actors"],"criticized":["Film is excessively long and monotonous","Repetitive footage of planes and troops slows pacing","Lacks depth beyond assembling a large cast","Shapeless storytelling and pretentious tone","Overall narrative feels tedious and unengaging"]}
